Custom icons for apps that aren't pinned (experimental), and a "What's new" screen.

**Download `iconger.exe` below**, or open Iconger: it will offer the update itself.

## New (experimental, off by default)
- **Apps that aren't pinned can get a custom icon too.** Apps that are open on your taskbar without being pinned now show up in Pinned apps under **Running now**. Pick one and Iconger offers to turn on the experimental feature.
- Iconger swaps the icon of the app's windows (taskbar button, title bar and Alt+Tab), and again every time you open the app. Nothing on disk changes.
- For that, Iconger keeps running in the background: closing its window hides it (you'll see it in Task Manager), and it starts with Windows. You can turn startup off, or quit Iconger completely, in **Settings > Apps that aren't pinned**.
- Known limits: some apps may flash their own icon for a moment or not take the new one, and apps running as administrator can't be changed. Tell us what you find!

## New
- **What's new:** after each update, Iconger shows what changed (this screen).

Your backups and settings carry over.
